title: program/evidence/<ID>/results.json
description: Written by pk's evidence kit (Evidence.write) and checked by `pk evidence validate`. The checker enforces the same shape in code; its list of required keys is read from this file.

head.description: the one commit the evidence binds to

main.description: SHA of the main branch when produced

inputs.description: root-relative path -> sha256 of the blob committed at head

argv.description: the literal command, never a shell string

as_expected.description: exit equals expected_exit and any parse succeeded

derived.description: fields parsed from the real output

output_sha256.description: over the full combined stdout and stderr

planted_bugs.description: one row per planted bug, then exactly one self-test row (id self-test-noncompiling, builds false, killed false)

killed.description: true only when the code built and the test failed

kill_reason.description: build failed iff builds is false; test failed iff killed; else not killed

planted_bugs_all_killed.description: over the rows except the self-test row

tree_unchanged_by_run.description: clean at the start, clean at the end, same HEAD
